# Synferrous

> Business analysis, e-commerce builds and practical AI assistants, delivered by Rohan Kapoor in Delhi NCR, India.

Synferrous is run by Rohan Kapoor, a techno-functional business analyst. Every engagement is scoped and delivered by him personally. Prices are starting points and exclude GST where applicable.

## Services
- [Requirements & Process Discovery](https://synferrous.com/services/requirements-process-discovery): Turn an idea or a messy process into a build-ready specification your developers or agency can quote against. From ₹45,000.
- [Fractional BA / Product Owner](https://synferrous.com/services/fractional-ba-product-owner): Part-time product ownership for a build in progress — backlog, specs, agency management and sign-off. ₹40,000 / month (20 hours).
- [UAT & Release Readiness](https://synferrous.com/services/uat-release-readiness): Structured user-acceptance testing before you go live, so defects are caught by you, not your customers. From ₹30,000 per release.
- [E-commerce Store Build & Launch](https://synferrous.com/services/ecommerce-store-build): A custom online store with live Razorpay payments and an admin your team can run without a developer. From ₹1,50,000.
- [Order Management & SFCC Process Consulting](https://synferrous.com/services/order-management-consulting): Process design and specification for order management flows — B2B, Back-to-Back, stock & sell and exceptions. ₹15,000 / day (2-day minimum).
- [Store Care Retainer](https://synferrous.com/services/store-care-retainer): Monitoring, small fixes and content changes for a live store, so it stays healthy after launch. ₹8,000 / month.
- [GA4 & Tag Manager Tracking Setup](https://synferrous.com/services/ga4-gtm-tracking-setup): E-commerce tracking you can trust — events, conversions and funnels that show where customers drop off. From ₹20,000.
- [Technical SEO Audit & Fix Plan](https://synferrous.com/services/technical-seo-audit): Find out why your pages aren't ranking or indexing — with a prioritised, developer-ready fix list. From ₹18,000.
- [AI Support Assistant for Your Website](https://synferrous.com/services/ai-support-assistant): A chat assistant that answers product, order and FAQ questions from your own content — and hands off to a human. From ₹60,000.
